_about: DM skeletons. They are starting points the agent personalises, never messages to paste unchanged. {{placeholders}} must all be filled (dm.py render refuses otherwise). 'trigger' says what must have happened before this message is appropriate.

keyword_delivery.trigger: They commented or DMed the keyword. They asked for this.

engaged_first_message.trigger: They engaged first (comment, story reply, poll answer) and a personal note makes sense.

story_reply_response.trigger: They replied to a story or answered a sticker.

inbound_lead_reply.trigger: They asked about price, availability or the offer.

collab_pitch.trigger: Manual, one person at a time, after you have genuinely engaged with their content. Never bulk.
collab_pitch.body:
Hi {{first_name}}, {{specific_thing_of_theirs_you_liked_and_why}}.

I make {{what_you_make}} for {{your_audience}}. Idea: {{the_collab_in_one_sentence}}. {{why_it_helps_their_audience}}.

Worth a look? If not, no worries.

lead_followup_1.trigger: They engaged in a conversation, then went quiet. 2-4 days later.

lead_followup_2.trigger: Still quiet about a week after follow-up 1. The last message in the thread.
lead_followup_2.body: Last one from me on this, {{first_name}}. {{close_the_loop_kindly}} Door's open whenever.

rules.automation: Automated DMs only through Instagram's own tools, the official Messaging API or Meta-approved partners, and only after the person messaged, commented or replied first. Standard messaging window: 24 hours from their last message.
never: messages pretending to be personal when they are not
